    14  # Presheaves on a topological space
    15  
    16  We define `TopCat.Presheaf C X` simply as `(TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C`,
    17  and inherit the category structure with natural transformations as morphisms.
    18  
    19  We define
    20  * Given `{X Y : TopCat.{w}}` and `f : X ⟶ Y`, we define
    21    `TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward C f : X.Presheaf C ⥤ Y.Presheaf C`,
    22    with notation `f _* ℱ` for `ℱ : X.Presheaf C`.
    23  
    24  and for `ℱ : X.Presheaf C` provide the natural isomorphisms
    25  * `TopCat.Presheaf.Pushforward.id : (𝟙 X) _* ℱ ≅ ℱ`
    26  * `TopCat.Presheaf.Pushforward.comp : (f ≫ g) _* ℱ ≅ g _* (f _* ℱ)`
    27    along with their `@[simp]` lemmas.
    28  
    29  We also define the functors `pullback C f : Y.Presheaf C ⥤ X.Presheaf c`,
    30  and provide their adjunction at
    31  `TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`.
    32  -/

    35

    44  /-- The category of `C`-valued presheaves on a (bundled) topological space `X`. -/

    47    (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C
